evidence.title: 🎵 Music Academy - Master the Art of Music

name: Music Academy
summary: Music academy web app built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4 and Framer Motion: 3D hero, course pages and a contact form.
description: A complete Next.js 16 App Router site for a music academy: 3D particle-sphere hero with spotlight and moving-border CTA, course cards and a course directory with dynamic detail pages and syllabus, sticky-scroll "Why Choose Us", testimonial marquee, instructor showcase with tooltips, webinar grid and a contact form backed by a server API route.
contains: routes: landing page, course directory, dynamic course detail, contact
3D particle-sphere hero, spotlight beams and moving-border CTA
sticky-scroll "Why Choose Us", testimonial marquee, instructor tooltips, webinar cards
contact form with Next.js API route and email dispatch
stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Aceternity UI, simplex-noise
